skills.name: convex
skills.description: Convex is the backend agents get right on the first try: an all-TypeScript reactive platform where the database, server functions, scheduling, file storage, auth, and realtime sync are one type-safe system, every function is a transaction, and `tsc` catches most mistakes before deploy.

skills.name: convex-add
skills.description: Add a capability to the CURRENT Convex app — consults the served Convex capability catalog for always-current procedures (billing, crons, auth, agent, search, …); falls back to built-in hosting or @convex-dev component search.

skills.name: convex-advisor
skills.description: Read the Convex deployment's 72h insights (read limits, OCC contention), root-cause each event in code, report evidence-backed perf/cost findings with fixes.

skills.name: convex-agent
skills.description: Add an AI agent / RAG backend (@convex-dev/agent) to the Convex app.

skills.name: convex-auth
skills.description: Add authentication (passkeys/OAuth) to the current Convex app, including the auth.config.ts wiring.

skills.name: convex-authz
skills.description: Audit and harden a Convex app's authorization: identity-from-arg impersonation, missing per-document ownership checks, public queries leaking data by a client-supplied id, and writes into a parent/container the caller doesn't own.

skills.name: convex-backup
skills.description: Set up Convex backups and run a restore DRILL that proves recovery — snapshot, restore into a throwaway preview, assert the data came back — plus a schedule matched to your RPO and a gated recovery runbook.

skills.name: convex-billing
skills.description: Add Stripe billing/payments to the Convex app via @convex-dev/stripe (checkout + webhook + gating).

skills.name: convex-cost
skills.description: Preview Convex spend — rank functions by bytes/documents-read × call-volume from insights, project each cost driver's growth curve, name the cheapest fix; confirm-cost for paid actions.

skills.name: convex-create-component
skills.description: Builds reusable Convex components with isolated tables and app-facing APIs.

skills.name: convex-crons
skills.description: Add recurring scheduled jobs (crons) to the Convex app.

skills.name: convex-deploy-guard
skills.description: Classify + announce the target Convex deployment before any deployment-affecting command; fresh explicit consent for prod actions; session read-only mode.

skills.name: convex-design
skills.description: Design and build reactive, type-safe, production-grade backends on Convex.

skills.name: convex-docs
skills.description: Pull version-current Convex docs for the version this project uses — pin the installed version, fetch page-as-markdown or check node_modules types, freshness hierarchy — instead of writing a possibly-stale API from memory.

skills.name: convex-domains
skills.description: Point a domain you already own at your Convex app (DNS records, custom-domain attach, auth-origin rebind).

skills.name: convex-env
skills.description: Set and wire Convex deployment env vars / secrets for the app.

skills.name: convex-expert
skills.description: Convex backend specialist.

skills.name: convex-explain-app
skills.description: Explain an existing Convex app — data model + relationships, public vs internal functions, auth/ownership model, components, a request→data flow — read from the schema and function surface.

skills.name: convex-improve-convex-plugin
skills.description: Send this coding session's transcript to the Convex team for an AI post-mortem that improves the quickstart system.

skills.name: convex-insights
skills.description: Query a running Convex app's logs + health in natural language (official MCP): failures, slow/expensive functions, deploy causality — scoped, evidence-backed, with a dashboard deep link.

skills.name: convex-launch-readiness
skills.description: Run every Convex audit (authz, reviewer, advisor, insights) into one scored, deduped readiness report with an ordered fix plan — Lighthouse for your backend.

skills.name: convex-migrate
skills.description: Migrate schema + backfill data on a deployed Convex app using @convex-dev/migrations.

skills.name: convex-migrate-rehearse
skills.description: Rehearse a live-app schema change + backfill on a snapshot-seeded preview deployment, verify, then promote the proven change to prod with the snapshot as rollback.

skills.name: convex-monitor
skills.description: Watch for the next dev/prod error or request in a Convex app and react to it.

skills.name: convex-optimize
skills.description: Audit and optimize an existing Convex app: security, scale, upgrades, observability.

skills.name: convex-quickstart
skills.description: Get a barebones Convex + web template running from a one-sentence idea.

skills.name: convex-reviewer
skills.description: Convex code reviewer — security, auth, validators, performance, and pattern checks for code in a convex/ directory.

skills.name: convex-seed
skills.description: Seed or import data into the Convex database.

skills.name: convex-self-heal
skills.description: Production error → triaged, root-caused, repaired, and certified (tsc + rehearsal + reproduce-then-gone) fix PR for a human to merge — then confirm the error stops recurring.

skills.name: convex-sentinel
skills.description: Set up Sentinel production error capture in your own Convex deployment.

skills.name: convex-suggest
skills.description: Suggest the matching Convex component when the user hand-rolls a pattern it already solves (crons, sharded-counter, rate-limiter, storage, search, presence, workflow, RAG, prosemirror-sync).

skills.name: convex-test
skills.description: Generate convex-test tests for the app's Convex functions.

skills.name: convex-verify
skills.description: Prove a Convex feature works — seed, drive as multiple mocked users via convex-test, assert behavior including the negative authz cases (wrong user refused, data-scope enforced).
